plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Venue Helper
plugins.Punchline: An all-in-one toolkit for FFXIV venue hosts: attendance, raffles, auctions, giveaways, deathroll tournaments, bar games, menus, and quick announcements.
plugins.Description: An all-in-one venue host toolkit: Venue Counter (multi-venue attendance + lifetime time tracking), Raffle Helper, Auction Helper (gil shorthand + buyer tracking), Giveaway Helper (anti-cheat), DR Tourny Helper (single or double elimination), Shout/Yell Helper, Bar Game Helper (custom + survival games, fixed/tiered/high-score payouts), Menu Helper (per-venue menus, macro serve sequences), plus a Settings tab with backup/restore and a master panic switch. Open with /venuehelper (aliases /vhelp, /vh). Exports to TXT, CSV, PDF, or XLSX.

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: FC Tracker
plugins.Punchline: Track your characters' Free Companies: level, tag, credits, house, and workshop vessels.
plugins.Description: Records, per character, the Free Company you belong to: name, tag, level, current master, member counts, FC credits, house ownership (district/ward/plot/world), and workshop airships & submersibles with build shorthand. Sortable table with click-to-expand details, a First Registered date, editable founder/house-winner notes, optional shared storage across all clients, and import from AutoRetainer and Submarine Tracker. Open with /fctracker (alias /fct).

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Housing Lotto Tracker
plugins.Punchline: Track your housing lottery bids: plot, world, entry number, results date, win/loss.
plugins.Description: Passively records every housing lottery bid you place, per character, by reading the placard when you interact with it. One row per bid: character/world, region, district, ward, plot, size, FC-vs-personal, entry date, results-available date with live countdown, and outcome (Pending/Won/Lost). Auto-captures placard data during entry and results periods; auto-detects wins via the results SelectYesno; entry number is grabbed when shown and editable otherwise. Sortable table with click-to-expand details, per-column toggles, editable notes, and optional shared storage across all clients. Open with /hlt (alias /lotto).

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Market Helper
plugins.Punchline: Undercut, list, gather and buy — market board automation end to end.
plugins.Description:
Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with five tabs:

UNDERCUT — Walk a summoning bell's retainers and undercut every listed item. HQ and NQ are handled separately, your own retainers are matched rather than undercut, per-item overrides and price memory are supported, an obvious troll price is skipped, and mannequin/display items are never touched (if a row can't be verified it is skipped rather than risk delisting it). Closes the bell when it finishes.

LISTER — Build a list (hold CTRL and hover an item, or search) and press Go to list them all. Prices each item at the most common market price, ignoring lone troll listings, against your world, data center or whole region. Per-item stack sizes and list amounts, rolls extra items to the next retainer at the 20-slot cap, and includes a no-touch dry run.

FLIPPER — Compare any marketable item across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modelling.

ITEM GATHERER — Pull designated items off your retainers into your bags, optionally returning your market listings first. Manual withdraw/deposit actions included.

BUYER — Build a shopping list by hand or import a MakePlace furniture list, then SCAN the market per world via Universalis and press SEND to travel with Lifestream and buy across worlds. Every purchase is verified against the game's own confirmation dialog before it is accepted. Listings are bought whole, so by default it never buys a bigger stack than you still need, and a hard sanity ceiling caps the price even with no cap set. If a planned listing has already been bought it chases the next cheapest, on other worlds if needed, until your order is filled. Dry run is on by default.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Consolidator
plugins.Description: Consolidates gil and items from your alt characters onto a single main, and hands items back out from that main to the alts. The alt side logs in, travels via Lifestream, walks to the receiver with vnavmesh, trades over everything above your floors, and returns to the FC. Requires AutoRetainer, Lifestream and vnavmesh; the receiving character can accept trades with Consolidator itself or Dropbox.
plugins.Punchline: Sweep gil from every alt onto one character.
